name: EC2 Get Password Data (Windows)
description: Windows EC2 instances can have their initial administrator password retrieved via ec2:GetPasswordData. The password is encrypted with the key pair used to launch the instance. An attacker with ec2:GetPasswordData and the private key can decrypt the password and use it for RDP access. This works for instances launched with a key pair; the password is available a few minutes after boot. Required permissions are ec2:GetPasswordData. The attacker must have the private key file corresponding to the instance's key pair.
